title: Bilateral pressure–compliance pairing adds no convincing cross-cycle tinnitus prediction beyond marginal audiologic measures
abstract: In 3,274 NHANES 2011–2012 adults aged 20–69 and 3,744 separately sampled 2015–2016 adults, adding a bilateral middle-ear pressure × log-compliance difference product to conventional audiologic summaries produced no convincing incremental tinnitus prediction: target weighted log-loss change −0.00009181 (−0.0233%), conditional95% bootstrap [−0.00045877,+0.00027173], source-plus-target refit95% [−0.00131320,+0.01002310]; source grouped-CV worsened. This tests one linear feature in complete cases with valid pressure, excluding low-compliance ears, not all tympanometric information.
